children.name: Dear Emma,  Hey there! I hope this letter finds you happy and doing well. It’s been a while since we last talked, so I thought I’d take a moment to write and catch up. Things on my end have been going pretty smoothly. Work has been keeping me busy, but I’ve also been trying to make time for some fun—reading a few good books and taking walks in the park. I’ve been thinking about our last trip together and how much fun we had. It really made me miss spending time with you. How have you been? How’s everything going with your job and your family? I’d love to hear all about what you’ve been up to lately. Let me know if you’ve discovered any new hobbies or gone on any adventures. Let’s try not to let too much time pass before we talk again. Maybe we can plan a phone call soon, or even meet up if we can swing it. I really miss our chats. Take care of yourself, and write back when you get a chance. I’d love to hear from you soon. Warmly, John

children.name: Dear John,  It’s so nice to hear from you! Your letter really made me smile. I’ve been doing well—work has been busy on my end too, but I’ve been enjoying it. My family is doing great, and we recently had a small gathering that was a lot of fun. I’ve actually picked up a new hobby lately: gardening. It’s been surprisingly relaxing, and I love seeing the plants grow little by little. No big adventures yet, but I’ve been taking some weekend trips nearby whenever I get the chance.  I also miss our chats and that trip we took together—it really was such a good time. A phone call sounds perfect; let’s plan one soon. Hopefully, we can arrange a visit in the near future as well.  Take care of yourself, and thank you again for writing. It was really wonderful to hear from you.  Warmly,  Emma
